Name: Level Up Stars
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
According to the code of the vanilla game, the screen that pops up during the night when you level up was supposed to have a star icon somewhere (aptly named "starIcon" in the code). It would shine when you hovered over it with your mouse. Unfortunately, that star icon never actually made it into the game and it is never shown on the screen.

Until now.

This mod implements not one but [i]two[/i] of those star icons on either side of the "Level Up" text on the level up screen. You can hover your mouse over them to make them shine. They look very pretty. This is a very important mod.

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
